name: Ring of Energy Weakness
body:
Aura faint (minor) or moderate (major or greater) abjuration; CL 3rd (minor), 7th (major), or 11th (greater); Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of energy resistance. Instead of imparting resistance to a specified energy type, the ring intensifies the damage inflicted to the wearer by that energy type and increases any saving throw DC to avoid damage from that energy type.

A minor ring of energy weakness increases damage from the specified energy type by 50% and increases the saving throw DC by 2.
A major ring of energy weakness increases damage from the specified energy type by 100% and increases the saving throw DC by 4.
A greater ring of energy weakness increases damage from the specified energy type by 200% and increases the saving throw DC by 6.

This ring can only be removed by casting remove curse upon it followed by resist energy. Do so renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of energy resistance

Identification DC 28 (minor), DC 32 (major), DC 36 (greater)
False Identification DC 18 (minor), DC 22 (major), DC 26 (greater)
